excerpt: HealthKart is an Indian online and offline store for supplements and sports nutrition, home to brands such as MuscleBlaze and HK Vitals. Founded in 2011.
content:
HealthKart sells sports nutrition, vitamins and supplements, Ayurvedic and herbal products, health foods and fitness gear online and through its own stores. Its website promotes brands including MuscleBlaze, HK Vitals, TrueBasics, Gritzo, bGREEN and MB Z Verse, and says every product it sells is 100% original and authentic.

Business Today reported that HealthKart was founded in 2011, originally as HealthKartPlus, by Sameer Maheshwari, its founder and CEO, and Prashant Tandon. In December 2022 the company announced USD 135 million in growth funding led by Temasek, with A91 Partners and Kae Capital. At the time it said its annual revenue run rate was above Rs 1,000 crore, and Business Today counted more than 140 HealthKart-branded offline stores.

There is no subscription to buy: you pay the listed price for each product. HealthKart runs a loyalty programme called HK Premium and a cashback balance called HK Cash, credited after the 7-day return window, but its homepage does not publish an HK Premium price.

Supplements are not a substitute for medical advice; check with a doctor before starting one, especially if you take medication. This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting. We have not tested the product for this page, and nothing here is paid placement.
